text:
Same money, two steel sports watches. Which one would you pick?

Rolex Explorer 40 (ref 224270) is $8,350. Omega Seamaster Diver 300M (ref 210.30.42.20.03.004) is $8,600.

The Explorer is plain and easy to read. The Diver adds a blue wave dial and a steel mesh strap, rated to 300 metres.

Prices: B.C. Clark (Rolex, checked 25 November 2026); Omega USA (Seamaster Diver, checked 26 November 2026). US list prices.

Source: B.C. Clark; Omega USA. Photo: Rolex, Omega.
